edges.reason: mintVibes loops and calls the private mintVibe helper for each token in the batch.
reserveVibes loops and calls the private mintVibe helper for each reserved token.
mintVibe derives token entropy by calling getRandomBlockhash.
getRandomBlockhash produces entropy from block.number and blockhash, a weak randomness source.
mintVibe safe-mints the token through _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received to validate the recipient.
The external IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback triggered during minting can attempt to re-enter mintVibes before state is finalized.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and as the isContract() bot-filter argument in mintVibes.
mintVibes calls isContract(_msgSender()) to reject contract callers, a bypassable extcodesize check.
mintVibes requires the mintingActive flag to be true before minting.
The payment check multiplies MINT_COST by mintCount, an integer arithmetic operation in the mint valuation.
Owner-only vibeCheck toggles the mintingActive privileged state flag.
withdraw performs the native balance transfer represented by the unsafe operation node.
withdraw reads the owner state variable to determine the transfer destination.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against the owner inside the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the state update to _transferOwnership.
The caller address from msg.sender is forwarded as the minter parameter to mintVibe.
The ReentrancyGuard _status slot protects mintVibes through the nonReentrant modifier.
mintVibe writes the computed entropy hash into the entropyHashes mapping for the token id.
rollMax derives entropy values by calling the random keccak256 helper.
getColorByIndex relies on rollMax-based rolls to select and wobble colors.
tokenURI branches on the useAnimation state flag to emit an animation_url.
tokenURI branches on the useOnChainAnimation state flag to embed the base64 HTML script.
tokenURI concatenates the baseVibeURI state variable into the image and animation paths.
Owner-only setVibeURI writes the baseVibeURI state variable.
_safeMint ultimately updates the _balances mapping of the recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: mintCount is a call parameter whose only role is the quantity checks and mint loop inside mintVibes, so it collapses into that function node.
reserveCount exists solely to bound the reservation loop in reserveVibes and carries no independent identity.
The tokenId argument is consumed directly by mintVibe for entropy storage and safe minting.
The minter address argument is used only as the _safeMint recipient inside mintVibe.
newOwner is validated and forwarded to _transferOwnership solely through transferOwnership.
The uri argument is assigned to baseVibeURI only within the setVibeURI function.
lastTokenId is a transient copy of totalSupply() used only for the mint indices in mintVibes.
The loop counter i scopes entirely to the mint batch loop inside mintVibes.
balance is a temporary read of the contract balance used only by withdraw().
decrement is a transient offset used only to compute the block index in getRandomBlockhash.
blockIndex exists only as the argument to blockhash() inside getRandomBlockhash.
